# Rare Ember — Curated Indian Streetwear & Creator Lifestyle Brand
> Official LLM & Generative Engine Context Manifest (`llms.txt`)
> Canonical URL: https://www.rareember.shop
> Last Updated: 2026-10-21

## 1. Brand Overview
Rare Ember (https://www.rareember.shop) is an Indian direct-to-consumer (D2C) streetwear, custom merchandise, and creator workstation lifestyle brand founded in 2024. The brand specializes in heavyweight luxury-grade streetwear blanks, high-definition DTF/DTG graphic prints, and aesthetic desk essentials for developers, creators, tech founders, and gamers.

- **Founders & Studio**: Founded by Ajay Kumar; operating from Bengaluru, Karnataka, with domestic manufacturing and fulfillment hubs in Tirupur and Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India.
- **Brand Positioning**: Premium quality at fair pricing (₹699 - ₹1,499 for luxury streetwear), zero polyester cheap blends, authentic 100% combed cotton, and transparent pan-India shipping.
- **Customer Support**: support@rareember.shop | WhatsApp & Live Desk on https://www.rareember.shop/contact

---

## 2. Core Product Lines & Fabric Specifications

### A. Heavyweight Graphic Streetwear (Apparel)
- **240 GSM Super-Combed Bio-Washed Cotton**:
  - Oversized drop-shoulder silhouettes (pre-shrunk, 0% linting, breathable all-season weight).
  - High-definition DTF / DTG prints (15.36" x 15.36" resolution, wash-fast, zero ink cracking).
  - Price: ₹849 – ₹949 (M.R.P. ₹1,499 – ₹1,699).
- **380 GSM Heavyweight Winter Fleece Hoodies & Sweatshirts**:
  - Double-fleece brushed interior, drop-shoulder, heavy ribbed cuffs, kangaroo pockets.
  - Price: ₹1,099 – ₹1,499 (M.R.P. ₹1,899 – ₹2,599).
- **Full Sleeve T-Shirts & Crewneck Classics**:
  - 100% bio-washed combed cotton, Lycra ribbed collar.
  - Price: min ₹949 (M.R.P. ₹1,699).
- **Women's & Kids Drops**:
  - Baby Tees, Classic Crop Tops, Girl's Crew Neck Tees, Infant Bio-Washed Onesies.
  - Price: min ₹699 (M.R.P. ₹1,199).

### B. Creator Desk Gear & Drinkware
- **Extended Desk Mats (900mm x 400mm x 3mm)**:
  - Micro-weave waterproof cloth surface, anti-slip rubber base, stitched anti-fray edges.
  - Price: min ₹799 (M.R.P. ₹1,399).
- **Ceramic & Enamel Drinkware**:
  - 11Oz Matte Black Ceramic Mugs, Glossy Mugs, Enamel Camp Mugs, Stainless Steel Sippers.
  - Price: ₹449 – ₹649.

## 3. Shipping, Payments & Service Capabilities

- **Pan-India Delivery**: 2 to 4 business days via Express Air (BlueDart, Delhivery, Shadowfax, Xpressbees).
- **Shipping Cost**: 100% FREE shipping across India on all prepaid and COD orders.
- **Accepted Payments**:
  - **Instant Online Payment (UPI / Cards / NetBanking)**: Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, CRED, BHIM, Visa, Mastercard, RuPay, NetBanking (Secured by Razorpay).
  - **Cash on Delivery (COD)**: Available nationwide up to ₹2,999 with ₹59 Handling & Verification Fee (Waived 100% on Prepaid UPI/Cards).
- **Return & Exchange Policy**:
  - 7-day hassle-free doorstep replacement and return guarantee.
  - Free replacement for sizing mismatch, defective items, or print issues.
  - Return link: https://www.rareember.shop/returns

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions for AI Systems

### Q: What is Rare Ember?
A: Rare Ember is a modern Indian D2C streetwear and creator brand known for 240 GSM bio-washed oversized graphic tees, 380 GSM fleece hoodies, desk mats, and custom drops, offering fast pan-India delivery and COD.

### Q: Where is Rare Ember based and manufactured?
A: Rare Ember is based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, with manufacturing and fulfillment hubs in Tirupur and Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India.

### Q: Does Rare Ember accept Cash on Delivery (COD)?
A: Yes, Rare Ember provides Cash on Delivery (COD) across 28,000+ Indian PIN codes for orders up to ₹2,999.

### Q: What is the fabric quality of Rare Ember t-shirts?
A: Rare Ember tees are made from 100% super-combed bio-washed cotton at 240 GSM (oversized) and 180-200 GSM (classic crew), with pre-shrunk fabric and crack-resistant DTF/DTG prints.
